people.name: Achish
people.line: Philistine king of Gath, gave refuge to David

people.name: Gath
people.line: Philistine city; home of Goliath; refuge for David

people.name: Shimei
people.line: Benjamite who cursed David during Absalom's rebellion.

translations.web: Shimei arose, saddled his donkey, and went to Gath to Achish, to seek his slaves; and Shimei went, and brought his slaves from Gath.
translations.bsb: So Shimei saddled his donkey and set out to Achish at Gath in search of his slaves, and he brought them back from Gath.
translations.kjv: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants: and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.
translations.asv: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish, to seek his servants; and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.
